name: East Forest
reason: A music project rather than a teacher: his own about page calls East Forest 'the project of multidisciplinary artist Krishna-Trevor Oswalt', his work is mainly albums, concert tours (Doorway Tour) and psilocybin journey soundtracks, his YouTube is mostly music, and his paid offerings (Music for Mushrooms Journey Toolkit, Insider Collection) and one of his two Esalen programmes ('How Psychedelics Work ... and Healing') are framed around psychedelic healing; the yoga and breathwork at his Esalen retreats are led by Marisa Radha Weppner.
